global: This miso ramen features a rich, amber broth, topped with tender chashu pork and a halved boiled egg, garnished with sliced green onions. Served in a glossy red bowl, it rests on a dark wooden surface under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, appearing smooth and slightly reflective.
regions.bowl: Red ceramic bowl with glossy finish, smooth curved rim, and subtle speckled texture visible on its surface.
regions.soup: The miso broth is golden-brown, glossy, and thick, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows creamy white albumen surrounding a soft, pale yellow yolk with subtle marbling.
regions.meat: Chashu pork appears tender, thinly sliced, with glistening surface and visible fat marbling, some pieces curled slightly.
